flags.detail: The headline and morning_brew incorrectly characterize the game against the Charlotte Hornets as a 'preseason' game, whereas the source data confirms it was a regular season game.

The headline and morning_brew claim the Celtics played their 'home opener' on Wednesday, October 14th, but the game occurred on Tuesday, October 14th, and the Celtics' 2025-26 season is already over per the season_overrides, making this a fabricated event.
The content incorrectly identifies the game date as 'Wednesday night' when the boxscore confirms it was played on Tuesday, 2026-10-14.
